latest_release.name: v2.6.0
latest_release.body:
### Major Changes
* Replaced web3.js with viem, added EIP-7702 claim batching and fixed contract calls (refill vaults work again)
* Added `yespower` PoW algorithm, a CPU-friendly hash for the PoW module; fixed failed hashes being accepted as valid shares
* Farming hardening: idle sessions are closed, hashrate is limited per connected time, IP-change restrictions, Zupass limits now apply per ticket
* Modernized faucet UI, added Devcon 8 `ticket-proof` module, NodeJS 24 executables, dependency updates

### Release Artifacts
| Release File  | Description |
| ------------- | ------------- |
| powfaucet-server-all [.tar.gz](https://github.com/pk910/PoWFaucet/releases/download/v2.6.0/powfaucet-server-all.tar.gz) / [.zip](https://github.com/pk910/PoWFaucet/releases/download/v2.6.0/powfaucet-server-all.zip) | PoWFaucet server for execution with local nodejs (recommended) |
| [powfaucet-server-win.exe](https://github.com/pk910/PoWFaucet/releases/download/v2.6.0/powfaucet-server-win.exe) | PoWFaucet all-in-one executable for windows (NodeJS 24, 64bit) |
| [powfaucet-server-linux](https://github.com/pk910/PoWFaucet/releases/download/v2.6.0/powfaucet-server-linux) | PoWFaucet all-in-one executable for linux (NodeJS 24, 64bit) |
| powfaucet-static [.tar.gz](https://github.com/pk910/PoWFaucet/releases/download/v2.6.0/powfaucet-static.tar.gz) / [.zip](https://github.com/pk910/PoWFaucet/releases/download/v2.6.0/powfaucet-static.zip) | PoWFaucet static folder (optional, see [Operator Wiki](https://github.com/pk910/PoWFaucet/wiki/Operator-Wiki)) |
